channel.title: The Ottawa Citizen - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Ottawa Citizen (ottawacitizen.com)

item.title: St. Patrick's Day parade makes lively return to Ottawa after six-year hiatus
item.description: Hundreds turned out on downtown streets to celebrate Irish culture for the first time in more than a half-dozen years.

item.title: Warren Foegele's Ottawa Senators debut comes in Seattle
item.description: The veteran NHL winger acquired from Los Angeles already had some connections in the Ottawa dressing room: Ottawa defenceman Jordan Spence; winger Michael Amadio; and centre Dylan Cozens.

item.title: Overdose calls decreased in Ottawa in 2025, although deadly surges continued
item.description: Overdose-related emergency department visits also dropped, but there was a dramatic increase in those visits between May and September.

item.title: Senators lose Jake Sanderson to injury, defeat Kraken handily
item.description: Sanderson left the game clutching his right shoulder after being slammed to the ice by Brandon Montour in a 7-4 win against the Seattle Kraken.

item.title: Senators player grades: Foegele makes Ottawa debut, Pinto has three points in important victory over Kraken
item.description: Newcomer Warren Foegele had a goal in his first game since being acquired in a ta trade, Shane Pinto had one of his best performances of the season, Tim Stutzle extended his point streak to 12 games, and Dylan Cozens scored in his fourth straight for the Senators, a 7-4 win against the Seattle Kraken.

item.title: CMHC index shows housing affordability crisis has spread to Ottawa
item.description: According to the index, the city experienced two waves of housing unaffordability, but things have largely stabilized.

item.title: Ottawa's tell-tale sign for long-awaited springtime isn't what you think
item.description: City workers spend more than a month each year breaking up ice to protect residents along the Rideau River from floods

item.title: Iranians march towards U.S. Embassy in support of strikes in Iran
item.description: Ralliers called on Reza Pahlavi, Iran's exiled crown prince, to become the country's next leader

item.title: Fans of Ottawa Senators waiting with bated breath for Jake Sanderson injury update
item.description: It's believed Ottawa Senators defenceman Jake Sanderson was undergoing further examination on Sunday to determine the extent of his injury

item.title: Cuts to IRCC set to download asylum housing costs onto cities like Ottawa
item.description: Cuts to Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada is set to off-load housing asylum costs to municipalities, cut preventive care for asylum seekers and weaken supports for "economic migrants"
